title: Office Wi-Fi troubleshooting
solution: Check that Wi-Fi is enabled and airplane mode is off. Reconnect to the approved office SSID. If the problem continues, restart the network adapter and report the device name and location to IT.

title: VPN connection troubleshooting
solution: Verify your internet connection, then restart the approved VPN client. Confirm that your account is active and MFA is working. Do not share your password or MFA code with support.

title: Laptop battery not charging
solution: Check the charger and power outlet. Inspect the cable for visible damage. Try a known-good approved charger if available. If the battery remains unresponsive, raise a hardware service request.

title: Printer not printing
solution: Check that the correct printer is selected, the printer has paper, and there are no visible error messages. Cancel stuck print jobs and retry. Contact IT if the queue remains blocked.

title: Application crash
solution: Restart the application and check for approved updates. Record the application name, version, exact error message, and steps that reproduce the issue before contacting IT.

title: Password reset and locked account
solution: Use the organization's approved self-service password reset process. Never send passwords, recovery codes, or MFA codes to another person. If the account is still locked, contact the service desk.

title: Email sending problem
solution: Check internet connectivity, mailbox capacity, recipient address, and attachment size. Restart the approved email client and retry. If the error persists, capture the exact error message.

title: Suspicious phishing email
solution: Do not click links, open attachments, or reply. Use the organization's approved phishing-report mechanism. If you entered credentials, contact the security team immediately and follow the organization's incident-response procedure.

title: Possible malware infection
solution: Disconnect the affected device from the network if your organization's incident procedure instructs you to do so. Do not delete evidence or install unapproved cleanup tools. Contact the security/IT team immediately.

title: Folder access request
solution: Provide the business reason, folder/resource name, and required access level through the approved access-request process. Access should be granted according to organizational policy.

title: Slow internet
solution: Check whether the slowdown affects one device or multiple users. Restart the approved network connection and record approximate times and affected services. Report widespread impact to IT.

title: General IT issue
solution: Provide the exact error message, affected application/device, steps already attempted, and when the problem started. IT support can use these details to investigate efficiently.
